summary: Military aircraft must avoid an equestrian event within 2 nautical miles of Royal Welsh Agricultural Society Showground, Powys, up to 2000 ft above ground.
text:
MIL ACFT SHALL AVOID AN EQUESTRIAN EVENT WI 2NM RADIUS OF PSN 
520935N 0032425W (ROYAL WELSH AGRICULTURAL SOCIETY SHOWGROUND, 
POWYS) LOW FLYING AREA 7 AND NIGHT SECTOR 5CN. SFC TO 2000FT AGL. 
EVENT CTC 01982 554418. 26/11/151/LFC.
